svg.title: Rhône Valley study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Northern Rhône; 2: Southern Rhône; 3: Condrieu; 4: Cornas; 5: Châteauneuf-du-Pape; 6: Gigondas; 7: Cairanne; 8: Vinsobres; 9: Tavel; 10: Lyon; 11: Grenoble; 12: Montpellier

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
